caption:
She whispers like a nursery rhyme, then screams without warning: Julie Christmas 🎙️

Born in Brooklyn on Christmas Day, she sang in Made Out of Babies and Battle of Mice. In 2016 she made a whole album with Cult of Luna, Mariner, and in 2024 she came back solo after 14 years with Ridiculous and Full of Blood.

Where to start: Supernatural, The Ash, The Wreck of S.S. Needle, Bow.

Send it to someone who loves scary voices 🖤
